content:
You are repairing a robot skill so the task succeeds.

TASK
The robot cannot see the boxes it is asked to move. The perception service starts, but it reports nothing the task layer can use, so every task fails before the first pick.

The repair surface is the workcell configuration: config/week1.yaml. Nothing in this task tells you which objects the workcell has.

You may only change these paths:
  - config/

Two actions are available. Prefer the second for large files:
  {"write_file": [path, content]} replaces the whole file.
  {"edit_file": [path, old_text, new_text]} replaces the first
   occurrence of old_text. old_text must match the file exactly.
  {"search": [path, pattern]} returns the matching lines and their
   numbers. Use it to find the place; a whole large file will not
   fit in the budget.
  {"read_file": [path, start, lines]} returns that window of the file.
Reading the file you are repairing is allowed in every condition;
so is reading this workspace's tests and task.md. Nothing else is.
Reply with a single JSON object: {"actions": [...], "claim_success": bool, "done": bool}. No prose outside the JSON.
